findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: THIS IS A REPEAT VIOLATION: Observed the surface to the right of the dish machine is not sealed to the wall. The inspector educated that surfaces that cannot be easily moved must be sealed to the wall to ensure that debris does not accumulate underneath. The surface can be sealed using caulking, flex tape, or another method. Ensure that the surface to the right of the dish machine is sealed to be a smooth, easily cleanable surface by the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.

findings.title: Wiping cloths: properly used and stored
findings.comment:
Observed the facility was storing previously wet wiping cloths in the triple sink and dry sanitizer buckets overnight. The PIC stated the cloths had been used yesterday for cleaning dishes. The inspector educated that dry clean wiping cloths may be stored anywhere but wet in-use wiping cloths must be stored in chemical sanitizer solutions between uses. When they are done being used the wiping cloths must be laundered. They CANNOT be left overnight and used the next day without laundering. The wiping clothes were removed from service to be laundered during the inspection. Ensure that wiping cloths are always stored correctly and laundered daily.

3-304.14: (A) Cloths in-use for wiping FOOD spills for TABLEWARE and carryout containers shall be dry and used for no other purpose. (B) Cloths in-use for wiping counters and EQUIPMENT surfaces shall be held between uses in chemical sanitizer at proper solution and laundered daily. (C) Cloths in-use for wiping raw animal FOOD surfaces shall be separate from other cloths. (D) Dry wiping cloths and sanitizing solution shall be free of FOOD debris and other soil. (E) Containers of sanitizing solution shall be stored off floor and used in manner to prevent contamination. (F) SINGLE-USE disposable sanitizer wipes shall be used in accordance with EPA labels.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed the surface to the right of the dish machine is not sealed to the wall. The inspector educated that surfaces that cannot be easily moved must be sealed to the wall to ensure that debris does not accumulate underneath. This can be accomplished by caulking the surface to the wall (this is done correctly on the surface to the left of the dish machine). The surface must be sealed to the wall by the next routine inspection. 

6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. (B) In TEMPORARY FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, floor may be material effectively treated to control dust and mud. Walls and ceilings may be material that protects interior from weather and windblown dust and debris.
